title: A pucca house, a tin-sheet kitchen and a broken promise
description: Deep within one of the Nilgiris’ remaining Shola forests—among the few patches not overtaken by exotic pine and eucalyptus plantations—stands a newly built house under the PMAY-G scheme in a Kurumba settlement.
